checks.title: Human readability of MCP inspector
checks.instructions: Open MCP from the right-side dock. Verify compact mode is scannable, then expand representative General, Stars / Scène, Settings and Bare Hands entries and confirm descriptions, optionality/defaults/constraints and output schemas are understandable without raw JSON.
preconditions: All automated Slice 07 QA is green.
checks.pass_condition: Inspector is visually coherent, easy to scan and detailed mode exposes the requested contract without clutter.
